about.text: A ropy soured milk of central and northern Sweden, traditionally made long and stringy with butterwort (Pinguicula, in Swedish tätört) or with a starter kept from an earlier batch. On summer farms (fäbodar) it kept for months.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.label: ferment with leaves
how.text: Traditionally, warm milk was poured over fresh butterwort leaves, whose surface carries Lactococcus with exopolysaccharide genes. These seed the ropy fermentation that thickens the milk.

links.name: Porcellato et al. 2016, J Dairy Sci (tettemelk, Pinguicula)
